{{Top|leg}}
A '''countertoxin''' was a type of medicine that could be used to treat patients that were suffering from the effects of [[Poison/Legends|poisons]], animal venoms, [[Disease/Legends|diseases]], and microbes.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
